title: An app cannot give each audience its own landing page
body:

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27386 said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` (report 6518223407, `out_of_scope_findings`). Rows 2 and 4 are taken in PR #28017.
Reach: any app shared by more than one audience. In HotCRM, moving Sales above Service moves service staff's landing to Leads (#27386 row 5).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the app or manifest key), then `domain:ui` (the console landing redirect).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "app landing page per audience persona visible predicate navigationContributions position" → #23610 (closed, `PageTypeSchema` wording), not this.

## Observed
An app's landing is its first shown navigation entry. `homePageId` is retired, and manifest `navigationContributions` only append.

## Wanted
- **Spec:** either a new app key (for example a landing list with `visible` predicates, first match wins), or contributions that declare a position. Landing: `packages/spec` `ui/app.zod.ts`, or the kernel `manifest.zod.ts` `navigationContributions`.
- **Console:** the landing redirect reads it.

Dedupe words: landing per persona, app landing visible predicate, navigationContributions position.

Related: #27386 (row 5).
